description: Detects prompt-modifier keywords (@ship, @present, @debug, @verify, @fresh, @prompt, @build, @fc) and injects the matching behavioural protocol; a prompt without one gets nothing. Stands down on machine-authored prompts, helper reports included. Kickoff check: a kickoff this sitting saves in .claude/prompts/ without its OWNER ASKED / THIS PROMPT ADDS / COST lines gets the @prompt rules back so it is rewritten; earlier sittings' kickoffs are left as they are (a probe before each save tells which is which).
